Name: Jehoahaz, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, reigned three months in Jerusalem, did evil, and was deposed by Pharaoh Necho, who carried him to Egypt where he died.
KeyStory: Jehoahaz deposed after three months and taken to Egypt.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hamutal, Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Three months is enough to show a heart: Jehoahaz chose evil and lost the throne his father had honoured.
